name: raavi-markdown-viewer
description: ویور و ویرایشگر دسکتاپ Markdown فارسی
author: Raavi

scripts.test:mermaid-release: npm run build && node --test tests/mermaid-dos.test.mjs && playwright test --config tests/mermaid-release.config.ts
scripts.build: cross-env WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vinext build && npm run verify:chunk-budgets
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/audio-blocks.test.ts tests/audio-pipeline.test.ts tests/audio-structure.test.ts tests/back-layer-controller.test.ts tests/live-preview-decorations.test.ts tests/mermaid-blocks.test.ts tests/mermaid-samples.test.ts tests/mermaid-scheduler.test.ts tests/mermaid-viewport.test.ts tests/raavi-assets.test.ts tests/text-direction.test.ts tests/word-export.test.ts && node --test tests/audio-protocol.test.mjs tests/audio-whisper-runtime.test.mjs tests/zip-extract.test.mjs tests/rendered-html.test.mjs tests/desktop-server.test.mjs tests/desktop-startup-overlay.test.mjs tests/landing-fallback.test.mjs && playwright test && npm run test:back-layers:e2e
scripts.test:desktop-access: node --import tsx --test tests/desktop-access.test.ts && playwright test --config tests/desktop-access.config.ts
scripts.test:file-explorer: node --import tsx --test tests/filesystem-contract.test.ts tests/browser-filesystem-adapter.test.ts && node --test tests/library-filesystem.test.mjs && playwright test --config tests/file-explorer.config.ts && playwright test --config tests/file-explorer-desktop.config.ts
scripts.test:reading-search: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/reading-document-index.test.ts tests/reading-search-service.test.ts && playwright test --config tests/reading-full-search.config.ts
scripts.test:commands: node --import tsx --test tests/command-palette.test.ts && playwright test --config tests/command-palette.config.ts
scripts.test:ai: node --import tsx --test tests/ai-preferences.test.ts && node --test tests/ai-preferences-store.test.mjs tests/codex-cli.test.mjs
scripts.test:live-edit: node --import tsx --test tests/block-range-resolver.test.ts tests/block-operations.test.ts tests/clipboard.test.ts tests/editor-mode.test.ts tests/editor-tools.test.ts tests/formula-blocks.test.ts tests/inline-markdown.test.ts tests/rich-blocks.test.ts tests/semantic-anchor.test.ts && playwright test --config tests/live-edit.config.ts
scripts.desktop:dir: npm run icons:app && npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --x64
scripts.desktop:pack: node scripts/ensure-update-signing-keys.mjs && npm run icons:app && npm run icons:file && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 && node scripts/verify-windows-installer.mjs
scripts.desktop:pack:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb tar.gz --x64
scripts.desktop:pack:linux:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --linux dir --x64 && python scripts/package-linux-portable.py
scripts.desktop:pack:mac: npm run icons:app && npm run icons:file && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal
scripts.desktop:pack:mac:arm64: npm run icons:app && npm run icons:file && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.desktop:pack:mac:x64: npm run icons:app && npm run icons:file && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64
scripts.test:obl12: node --import tsx --test tests/release-state-migration.test.ts tests/release-performance.test.ts && playwright test --config tests/obl12-release.config.ts && playwright test --config tests/desktop-access.config.ts
scripts.smoke:packaging: npm run smoke:web && npm run smoke:electron

linux.description: A local-first Persian Markdown viewer and editor with RTL/LTR handling, portable annotations, and Mermaid diagrams.
